subject.title: feat(workshop): allow restoring rejected proposals back to pending

question: Should rejected-proposal restore remain operator-only, or should agents also receive the documented model-facing action, and must restoration preserve durable rejection history?
rationale: The exact head implements UI, CLI, and admin RPC surfaces while public docs promise a model action, and the existing record shape does not establish whether clearing the sole rejection metadata is the intended product contract.

options.title: Operator-only with history
options.body: Keep UI, CLI, and admin RPC restore, remove the model-action claim, and preserve a durable rejection/restoration event.

options.title: Add agent restore
options.body: Implement and test restore in the model tool, including its approval policy and durable lifecycle-history semantics.

options.title: Pause restore
options.body: Retain the current one-way lifecycle until maintainers choose the supported surface and history contract.

recommendation.title: Operator-only with history
recommendation.body: Keep UI, CLI, and admin RPC restore, remove the model-action claim, and preserve a durable rejection/restoration event.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history most strongly connects him to the original Skill Workshop lifecycle, tool, UI, and documentation surfaces.
